_comment: Business rules learned from interviews and documents. Every value carries its source so the agent can cite it. Edit here, never in code.

site_port.source: UN/LOCODE of the nearest port, used to place the site on the map when the site has no coordinates

site_name.source: org_chart_v2.pdf / onboarding notes: distribution center Hamburg (DC-HAM)

voice.source: Dockside automatically rehearses calls with ElevenLabs or a local mock. Telephone mode uses only a configured demo destination on an ElevenLabs SIP line.

deadline.source: onboarding_notes.md; trucks to retail leave from Sun 20:00

receiving_buffer_hours.source: assumption: unload + book + stage before the last packing hour. Ask Felix / Katrin.

priority_product.source: memo_launch_priorities.docx + interview: CE first, Standard has low margin and is mostly ready

missed_copy_cost_eur.source: interview 2026-11-21: a missing Collector's Edition is refunded at 120 EUR. Standard sells later (memo)

approval_ladder.conflicts_with: approval_policy_PP-07.pdf says the top tier is CPO + CFO jointly. Interview is newer; flag to the user.

people.source: org_chart_v2.pdf (2026-11-21). Collector's Category Lead vacant until 2026-11-23 (Arjun Krishnan).

truck_sunday_ban.source: §30(3) StVO; port-road combined transport within 150 km exempt

staff_email.source: The challenge data has staff names but no addresses. Set known addresses here. The demo uses plus-addresses at the Gmail account configured in MAIL_FROM.

approval_by_kind.source: inspection_report_5000413063.pdf (concession signed by Supplier Quality and Category Lead); PP-07 (dock slots released by site lead)

cheap_fix_eur.source: assumption: drayage from CTA, a dock slot, a phone call or a terms confirmation is always worth doing, also for Standard. Validate with Maren.

assurance_example_eur.source: Buyer tool design discussion: illustrative standby premium, editable in the prototype. No supplier quote.

autonomy.source: Team decision: free actions go out immediately. Paid orders, trucks, dock slots and expediting under the Buyer limit (PP-07, < EUR 50k) that protect at least 10x their cost have a 15-minute stop window after email notification. Other paid actions, including paid quality concessions, require explicit approval.

followup.source: User decision 2026-11-22: nothing waits silently. After 2 quiet hours (sooner before a deadline) Dockside reminds, books the unload slot (stoppable) or escalates.

chase.source: Supplier Chaser runs in the Dockside service. Procurement escalations use Discord unless an internal email is configured by name.

site_aliases.source: Site names used in carrier and supplier communications

sources.source: Reviewed against the Soony portal export and launch workbooks.

localized_site_names.source: Site spelling in templates and supplier replies

spend_priority_guidance.value: Standard has low margin and sells next week. Avoid air freight and rush orders for Standard. Propose cheap drayage, a dock slot, a call or a terms confirmation for either edition.

master_db.source: Name of the rebuildable SQLite database in the customer data directory
